note: **1 Pelham Crescent and Holly Lodge, Clumber Road West, schedules 221 and 222 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Ernest F Bradley is the record's Ernest J, who headed 1 Pelham Crescent in 1921; his housekeeper Cicily is a Bradley by the register and most likely his daughter. The Broadheads of Holly Lodge are all new.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
